```{r}
screen_order_selection_compact <- function(X,
                                           train_ratio = 0.6,
                                           p_max = 5,
                                           q_max = 5,
                                           Npc = 1,
                                           m_const = 0.65,
                                           R_noise = 0,
                                           B = 100,
                                           burn_in = 200,
                                           fracdiff_trim = 100,
                                           seed = 1)
{
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  if (any(!is.finite(X)))
  {
    stop("X contains NA, NaN or Inf values.")
  }

  T <- ncol(X)

  train_end <- floor(T * train_ratio)

  if (train_end <= fracdiff_trim)
  {
    stop("The initial training sample is too short after applying fracdiff_trim.")
  }

  X_initial_train <- X[, 1:train_end, drop = FALSE]

  set.seed(seed)

  d_hat <- estimate_d_BC_LPWN2(
    X_initial_train,
    m_const = m_const,
    R_noise = R_noise,
    B = B,
    burn_in = burn_in
  )$d_BC_LPWN2

  d_hat <- as.numeric(d_hat)

  if (length(d_hat) != 1 ||
      !is.finite(d_hat))
  {
    stop("Estimated d is not a single finite value.")
  }

  if (d_hat == 0)
  {
    X_diff_initial_train <- X_initial_train
  } else {
    X_diff_initial_train <- FracDiff(t(X_initial_train), d_hat) %>%
      t()
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(X_diff_initial_train)))
  {
    stop("Fractionally differenced training curves contain NA or Inf.")
  }

  if (d_hat == 0)
  {
    X_diff_for_order_selection <- X_diff_initial_train
  } else {
    X_diff_for_order_selection <-
      X_diff_initial_train[
        ,
        (fracdiff_trim + 1):ncol(X_diff_initial_train),
        drop = FALSE
      ]
  }

  order_out <- select_order_far_full(
    X = X_diff_for_order_selection,
    p_max = p_max,
    q_max = q_max,
    Npc = Npc
  )

  p_est <- as.integer(order_out$p_hat)

  q_est <- as.integer(order_out$q_hat)

  if (length(p_est) != 1 ||
      length(q_est) != 1 ||
      !is.finite(p_est) ||
      !is.finite(q_est))
  {
    stop("Order selection did not return valid values for p_est and q_est.")
  }

  list(
    model_summary =
      tibble::tibble(
        T = T,
        train_end = train_end,
        d_hat = d_hat,
        p_est = p_est,
        q_est = q_est,
        total_order = p_est + q_est,
        Npc = Npc,
        fracdiff_trim = fracdiff_trim
      ),
    order_selection_detail = order_out
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(demography)
library(dplyr)

Swe_mortality <- read.demogdata(
  "Mx_1x1_sweden.txt",
  type = "mortality",
  label = "Sweden"
)

Swe_mortality <- Swe_mortality %>%
  extract.ages(
    ages = 1:90
  )

Swe_mortality$rate$male[
  !is.finite(
    Swe_mortality$rate$male
  ) |
    Swe_mortality$rate$male <= 0
] <- 10^-4

Swe_mortality$rate$female[
  !is.finite(
    Swe_mortality$rate$female
  ) |
    Swe_mortality$rate$female <= 0
] <- 10^-4

Swe_mortality_smooth <- smooth.demogdata(
  Swe_mortality,
  method = "mspline",
  age.grid = 1:90
)

x_mat_male <- Swe_mortality_smooth$rate$male %>%
  log()

x_mat_female <- Swe_mortality_smooth$rate$female %>%
  log()

dim(
  x_mat_male
)

dim(
  x_mat_female
)
```







```{r}
extract_real_data_metrics <- function(real_result)
{
  error_detail <-
    real_result$error_detail

  conformal_summary_detail <-
    real_result$conformal_summary_detail

  if (nrow(error_detail) == 0)
  {
    stop("error_detail is empty.")
  }

  if (nrow(conformal_summary_detail) == 0)
  {
    stop("conformal_summary_detail is empty.")
  }

  if (!"d_used" %in% names(error_detail))
  {
    error_detail$d_used <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!"d_used" %in% names(conformal_summary_detail))
  {
    conformal_summary_detail$d_used <- NA_real_
  }

  point_summary_long <- error_detail %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      horizon_stats =
        purrr::map(
          error,
          function(error_mat)
          {
            tibble::tibble(
              h =
                seq_len(
                  ncol(error_mat)
                ),

              SSE =
                apply(
                  error_mat,
                  2,
                  function(x)
                  {
                    x <- x[
                      is.finite(x)
                    ]

                    sum(
                      x^2
                    )
                  }
                ),

              SAE =
                apply(
                  error_mat,
                  2,
                  function(x)
                  {
                    x <- x[
                      is.finite(x)
                    ]

                    sum(
                      abs(x)
                    )
                  }
                ),

              n_forecast =
                apply(
                  error_mat,
                  2,
                  function(x)
                  {
                    sum(
                      is.finite(x)
                    )
                  }
                )
            )
          }
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      window_type,
      method,
      d_used,
      horizon_stats
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(
      horizon_stats
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      window_type,
      method,
      d_used,
      h
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      SSE =
        sum(
          SSE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      SAE =
        sum(
          SAE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      n_forecast =
        sum(
          n_forecast,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      RMSE =
        sqrt(
          SSE /
            n_forecast
        ),

      MAE =
        SAE /
          n_forecast,

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      window_type,
      method,
      h
    )

  ratio_summary <- point_summary_long %>%
    dplyr::select(
      window_type,
      method,
      h,
      d_used,
      RMSE,
      MAE
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from =
        method,

      values_from =
        c(
          d_used,
          RMSE,
          MAE
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      RMSE_ratio =
        RMSE_farma /
          RMSE_far,

      MAE_ratio =
        MAE_farma /
          MAE_far
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      window_type,
      h
    )

  interval_summary <- conformal_summary_detail %>%
    dplyr::select(
      window_type,
      method,
      d_used,
      alpha,
      h,
      ECP,
      CPD,
      Score
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      window_type,
      method,
      alpha,
      h
    )

  list(
    point_summary_long =
      point_summary_long,

    ratio_summary =
      ratio_summary,

    interval_summary =
      interval_summary
  )
}
```





```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

process_boe_glc_sheet <- function(
    file,
    sheet = "1. fwds, short end",
    min_points_per_day = 10,
    min_date_coverage = 0.80,
    target_grid = NULL,
    remove_missing_days = TRUE
) {

  raw <- readxl::read_excel(
    file,
    sheet = sheet,
    col_names = FALSE
  )

  raw <- as.data.frame(raw)

  years_row <- which(
    apply(
      raw,
      1,
      function(x) {
        any(
          grepl(
            "years",
            as.character(x),
            ignore.case = TRUE
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )[1]

  if (is.na(years_row)) {
    stop("Cannot find the maturity-years row.")
  }

  maturity <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      unlist(
        raw[years_row, -1]
      )
    )
  )

  date_raw <- raw[[1]]

  date_1 <- suppressWarnings(
    as.Date(
      date_raw,
      format = "%d %b %y"
    )
  )

  date_2 <- suppressWarnings(
    as.Date(
      as.numeric(date_raw),
      origin = "1899-12-30"
    )
  )

  dates <- date_1

  dates[is.na(dates)] <- date_2[is.na(dates)]

  data_start <- which(!is.na(dates))[1]

  if (is.na(data_start)) {
    stop("Cannot find the first data row.")
  }

  dates <- dates[data_start:nrow(raw)]

  value_raw <- raw[
    data_start:nrow(raw),
    -1,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  value_mat <- apply(
    value_raw,
    2,
    function(x) {
      x <- as.character(x)

      x <- stringr::str_trim(x)

      x[x %in% c("", "na", "NA", "Na", "n/a", "N/A")] <- NA

      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(x)
      )
    }
  )

  value_mat <- as.matrix(value_mat)

  keep_col <- is.finite(maturity)

  maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    keep_col,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  keep_row <- !is.na(dates)

  dates <- dates[keep_row]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    keep_row,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  coverage_by_maturity <- colMeans(
    is.finite(value_mat)
  )

  keep_col <- coverage_by_maturity >= min_date_coverage

  maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    keep_col,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  ord <- order(maturity)

  maturity <- maturity[ord]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    ord,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (is.null(target_grid)) {
    target_grid <- maturity
  }

  interp_mat <- t(
    apply(
      value_mat,
      1,
      function(y) {

        ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(maturity)

        if (sum(ok) < min_points_per_day) {
          return(
            rep(
              NA_real_,
              length(target_grid)
            )
          )
        }

        approx(
          x = maturity[ok],
          y = y[ok],
          xout = target_grid,
          rule = 1
        )$y
      }
    )
  )

  if (remove_missing_days) {

    keep_day <- apply(
      interp_mat,
      1,
      function(x) {
        all(is.finite(x))
      }
    )

    interp_mat <- interp_mat[
      keep_day,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    dates <- dates[keep_day]
  }

  X <- t(interp_mat)

  rownames(X) <- target_grid

  colnames(X) <- as.character(dates)

  list(
    X = X,
    dates = dates,
    maturity = target_grid,
    sheet = sheet,
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      sheet = sheet,
      start_date = min(dates),
      end_date = max(dates),
      n_days = length(dates),
      n_maturities = nrow(X),
      min_maturity = min(target_grid),
      max_maturity = max(target_grid)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
boe_sheets <- c(
  "1. fwds, short end",
  "2. fwd curve",
  "3. spot, short end",
  "4. spot curve"
)

boe_screen <- purrr::map_dfr(
  boe_sheets,
  function(sheet_i) {

    dat_i <- process_boe_glc_sheet(
      file = "glcnominalddata/GLC Nominal daily data_2016 to 2024.xlsx",
      sheet = sheet_i,
      min_points_per_day = 10,
      min_date_coverage = 0.80
    )

    result_i <- rolling_forecasting_pipeline_compact(
      X = dat_i$X,
      h_max = 10,
      train_ratio = 0.6,
      valid_ratio = 0.2,
      alpha_set = c(0.2, 0.05),
      window_types = c("expanding"),
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = 100,
      far_pve = 0.95,
      fracdiff_trim = 100,
      seed = 111
    )

    result_i$model_summary %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        sheet = sheet_i,
        n_days = ncol(dat_i$X),
        n_maturities = nrow(dat_i$X),
        min_maturity = min(dat_i$maturity),
        max_maturity = max(dat_i$maturity)
      )
  }
)

boe_screen %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sheet,
    n_days,
    n_maturities,
    min_maturity,
    max_maturity,
    d_hat,
    p_est,
    q_est
  )
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)

process_rba_f17_sheet <- function(
    file,
    sheet = "Yields",
    drop_zero_maturity = TRUE,
    min_date_coverage = 0.80,
    target_grid = NULL,
    remove_missing_days = TRUE
) {

  raw <- readxl::read_excel(
    file,
    sheet = sheet,
    col_names = FALSE
  )

  raw <- as.data.frame(raw)

  series_row <- which(
    as.character(raw[[1]]) == "Series ID"
  )[1]

  if (is.na(series_row)) {
    stop("Cannot find Series ID row.")
  }

  title_row <- which(
    as.character(raw[[1]]) == "Title"
  )[1]

  if (is.na(title_row)) {
    stop("Cannot find Title row.")
  }

  maturity_text <- as.character(
    unlist(
      raw[title_row, -1]
    )
  )

  maturity <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      stringr::str_match(
        maturity_text,
        "([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*)\\s*yrs"
      )[, 2]
    )
  )

  data_start <- series_row + 1

  date_raw <- raw[[1]][data_start:nrow(raw)]

  date_num <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(date_raw)
  )

  dates <- as.Date(
    date_num,
    origin = "1899-12-30"
  )

  value_raw <- raw[
    data_start:nrow(raw),
    -1,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  value_mat <- apply(
    value_raw,
    2,
    function(x) {
      x <- as.character(x)
      x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
      x[x %in% c("", "na", "NA", "Na", "n/a", "N/A")] <- NA
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    }
  )

  value_mat <- as.matrix(value_mat)

  keep_col <- is.finite(maturity)

  maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    keep_col,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (drop_zero_maturity) {

    keep_col <- maturity > 0

    maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

    value_mat <- value_mat[
      ,
      keep_col,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  keep_row <- !is.na(dates)

  dates <- dates[keep_row]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    keep_row,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  coverage_by_maturity <- colMeans(
    is.finite(value_mat)
  )

  keep_col <- coverage_by_maturity >= min_date_coverage

  maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    keep_col,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  ord <- order(maturity)

  maturity <- maturity[ord]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    ord,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!is.null(target_grid)) {

    interp_mat <- t(
      apply(
        value_mat,
        1,
        function(y) {

          ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(maturity)

          if (sum(ok) < 5) {
            return(
              rep(
                NA_real_,
                length(target_grid)
              )
            )
          }

          approx(
            x = maturity[ok],
            y = y[ok],
            xout = target_grid,
            rule = 1
          )$y
        }
      )
    )

    maturity <- target_grid
    value_mat <- interp_mat
  }

  if (remove_missing_days) {

    keep_day <- apply(
      value_mat,
      1,
      function(x) {
        all(is.finite(x))
      }
    )

    value_mat <- value_mat[
      keep_day,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    dates <- dates[keep_day]
  }

  X <- t(value_mat)

  rownames(X) <- maturity

  colnames(X) <- as.character(dates)

  list(
    X = X,
    dates = dates,
    maturity = maturity,
    sheet = sheet,
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      sheet = sheet,
      start_date = min(dates),
      end_date = max(dates),
      n_days = length(dates),
      n_maturities = nrow(X),
      min_maturity = min(maturity),
      max_maturity = max(maturity)
    )
  )
}

subset_rba_by_date <- function(
    dat,
    start_date = NULL,
    end_date = NULL
) {

  dates <- dat$dates

  keep <- rep(TRUE, length(dates))

  if (!is.null(start_date)) {
    keep <- keep & dates >= as.Date(start_date)
  }

  if (!is.null(end_date)) {
    keep <- keep & dates <= as.Date(end_date)
  }

  X_sub <- dat$X[
    ,
    keep,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  dates_sub <- dates[keep]

  list(
    X = X_sub,
    dates = dates_sub,
    maturity = dat$maturity,
    sheet = dat$sheet,
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      sheet = dat$sheet,
      start_date = min(dates_sub),
      end_date = max(dates_sub),
      n_days = length(dates_sub),
      n_maturities = nrow(X_sub),
      min_maturity = min(dat$maturity),
      max_maturity = max(dat$maturity)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(datetime),
    is.finite(close),
    close > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    trading_date,
    datetime
  )

spy_minute <- spy_dat %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    trading_date,
    datetime,
    time
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    close = dplyr::last(close),
    volume = sum(volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    time >= "07:30:00",
    time <= "13:59:00"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    trading_date,
    datetime
  )

spy_minute <- spy_minute %>%
  dplyr::group_by(trading_date) %>%

  ) %>%

  dplyr::filter(
    n_minute_day >= 390
  )

  dplyr::group_by(trading_date) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:390) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    minute_index = dplyr::row_number(),
```

```{r}
screen_order_selection_no_d <- function(X,
                                        train_ratio = 0.6,
                                        p_max = 5,
                                        q_max = 5,
                                        Npc = 1)
{
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  if (any(!is.finite(X))) {
    stop("X contains NA, NaN or Inf values.")
  }

  T <- ncol(X)

  train_end <- floor(T * train_ratio)

  X_initial_train <- X[, 1:train_end, drop = FALSE]

  order_out <- select_order_far_full(
    X = X_initial_train,
    p_max = p_max,
    q_max = q_max,
    Npc = Npc
  )

  p_est <- as.integer(order_out$p_hat)

  q_est <- as.integer(order_out$q_hat)

  list(
    model_summary =
      tibble::tibble(
        T = T,
        train_end = train_end,
        d_hat = 0,
        p_est = p_est,
        q_est = q_est,
        total_order = p_est + q_est,
        Npc = Npc
      ),
    order_selection_detail = order_out
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(fds)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

data(ECBYieldcurve)
data(Yieldcurve)
data(FedYieldcurve)

extract_fds_matrix <- function(obj) {
  
  if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    X <- obj
  } else if (!is.null(obj$y)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$y)
  } else if (!is.null(obj$data)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$data)
  } else {
    stop("Cannot extract matrix.")
  }
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  storage.mode(X) <- "numeric"
  
  X
}

prepare_yield_X <- function(X) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  keep_col <- apply(
    X,
    2,
    function(x) all(is.finite(x))
  )
  
  X <- X[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_row <- apply(
    X,
    1,
    function(x) all(is.finite(x))
  )
  
  X <- X[keep_row, , drop = FALSE]
  
  X
}

screen_one_yield <- function(dataset_name,
                             fracdiff_trim = 20,
                             B = 199,
                             seed = 111) {
  
  obj <- get(dataset_name)
  
  X <- extract_fds_matrix(obj)
  X <- prepare_yield_X(X)
  
  out <- tryCatch(
    screen_order_selection_compact(
      X = X,
      train_ratio = 0.6,
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = B,
      fracdiff_trim = fracdiff_trim,
      seed = seed
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  
  if (inherits(out, "error")) {
    return(
      tibble(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        n_grid = nrow(X),
        T = ncol(X),
        d_hat = NA_real_,
        p_est = NA_integer_,
        q_est = NA_integer_,
        total_order = NA_integer_,
        error_message = out$message
      )
    )
  }
  
  out$model_summary %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      n_grid = nrow(X),
      total_order = p_est + q_est,
      error_message = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(
      dataset,
      n_grid,
      T,
      train_end,
      d_hat,
      p_est,
      q_est,
      total_order,
      fracdiff_trim,
      error_message
    )
}

yield_names <- c(
  "ECBYieldcurve",
  "Yieldcurve",
  "FedYieldcurve"
)

yield_screen <- map_dfr(
  yield_names,
  screen_one_yield,
  fracdiff_trim = 100,
  B = 199,
  seed = 1
)

yield_screen %>%
  arrange(desc(total_order), dataset)
```





```{r}
screen_temp_windows <- function(X,
                                dataset_name,
                                window_size = 365,
                                step_size = 90,
                                fracdiff_trim = 50,
                                B = 199,
                                seed = 111) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  T <- ncol(X)
  
  start_vec <- seq(
    1,
    T - window_size + 1,
    by = step_size
  )
  
  purrr::map_dfr(
    start_vec,
    function(s) {
      
      e <- s + window_size - 1
      
      X_sub <- X[, s:e, drop = FALSE]
      
      out <- tryCatch(
        screen_order_selection_compact(
          X = X_sub,
          train_ratio = 0.6,
          p_max = 5,
          q_max = 5,
          Npc = 1,
          B = B,
          fracdiff_trim = fracdiff_trim,
          seed = seed
        ),
        error = function(err) err
      )
      
      if (inherits(out, "error")) {
        return(
          tibble::tibble(
            dataset = dataset_name,
            window_size = window_size,
            start_col = s,
            end_col = e,
            T = ncol(X_sub),
            d_hat = NA_real_,
            p_est = NA_integer_,
            q_est = NA_integer_,
            total_order = NA_integer_,
            error_message = out$message
          )
        )
      }
      
      out$model_summary %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          dataset = dataset_name,
          window_size = window_size,
          start_col = s,
          end_col = e,
          total_order = p_est + q_est,
          error_message = NA_character_
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          dataset,
          window_size,
          start_col,
          end_col,
          T,
          d_hat,
          p_est,
          q_est,
          total_order,
          error_message,
          dplyr::everything()
        )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(fds)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

data(SAelectdemand)

extract_fds_matrix <- function(obj) {
  
  if (!is.null(obj$y)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$y)
  } else if (!is.null(obj$data)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$data)
  } else if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    X <- obj
  } else {
    stop("Cannot extract matrix.")
  }
  
  storage.mode(X) <- "numeric"
  X
}

prepare_positive_X <- function(X, small_value = 10^-6) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  X[is.na(X)] <- small_value
  X[X <= 0] <- small_value
  
  X <- log(X)
  
  keep_col <- apply(
    X,
    2,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_row <- apply(
    X,
    1,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[keep_row, , drop = FALSE]
  
  X
}

center_by_group_train <- function(X, groups, train_ratio = 0.6) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  groups <- as.character(groups)
  
  if (length(groups) != ncol(X)) {
    stop("length(groups) must equal ncol(X).")
  }
  
  train_end <- floor(ncol(X) * train_ratio)
  train_idx <- 1:train_end
  
  X_centered <- X
  
  global_mean <- rowMeans(
    X[, train_idx, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  group_mean_list <- list()
  
  for (g in unique(groups)) {
    
    idx_train_g <- train_idx[groups[train_idx] == g]
    
    if (length(idx_train_g) == 0) {
      mean_g <- global_mean
    } else {
      mean_g <- rowMeans(
        X[, idx_train_g, drop = FALSE],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
    
    idx_all_g <- which(groups == g)
    
    X_centered[, idx_all_g] <- sweep(
      X[, idx_all_g, drop = FALSE],
      1,
      mean_g,
      "-"
    )
    
    group_mean_list[[g]] <- mean_g
  }
  
  list(
    X = X_centered,
    groups = groups,
    group_mean_list = group_mean_list,
    train_end = train_end
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

make_scores_for_far_order <- function(X,
                                      K = NULL,
                                      pve = 0.95,
                                      center = TRUE)
{
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  if (center) {
    mean_curve <- rowMeans(X, na.rm = TRUE)
    Xc <- sweep(X, 1, mean_curve, "-")
  } else {
    mean_curve <- rep(0, nrow(X))
    Xc <- X
  }

  cov_op <- cov(t(Xc))

  eig <- eigen(cov_op, symmetric = TRUE)

  eig_values <- eig$values
  eig_vectors <- eig$vectors

  eig_values[eig_values < 0] <- 0

  if (is.null(K)) {
    pve_vec <- cumsum(eig_values) / sum(eig_values)
    K <- which(pve_vec >= pve)[1]
  }

  phi <- eig_vectors[, 1:K, drop = FALSE]

  scores <- t(phi) %*% Xc

  list(
    scores = t(scores),
    phi = phi,
    mean_curve = mean_curve,
    K = K,
    pve = sum(eig_values[1:K]) / sum(eig_values)
  )
}

fit_score_var_resid <- function(scores, p)
{
  scores <- as.matrix(scores)

  T <- nrow(scores)
  K <- ncol(scores)

  if (p == 0) {
    Y <- scores
    Xreg <- matrix(1, nrow = T, ncol = 1)
  } else {
    idx <- (p + 1):T

    Y <- scores[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    Xreg <- matrix(1, nrow = length(idx), ncol = 1)

    for (j in 1:p) {
      Xreg <- cbind(
        Xreg,
        scores[idx - j, , drop = FALSE]
      )
    }
  }

  coef_hat <- solve(
    crossprod(Xreg),
    crossprod(Xreg, Y)
  )

  resid <- Y - Xreg %*% coef_hat

  Sigma <- crossprod(resid) / nrow(resid)

  list(
    resid = resid,
    Sigma = Sigma,
    n = nrow(resid),
    K = K,
    p = p
  )
}

safe_logdet <- function(Sigma, ridge = 1e-8)
{
  Sigma <- as.matrix(Sigma)

  K <- nrow(Sigma)

  Sigma <- Sigma + diag(ridge, K)

  as.numeric(determinant(Sigma, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus)
}

kr_test_one_lag <- function(scores, p_restricted, ridge = 1e-8)
{
  scores <- as.matrix(scores)

  p_full <- p_restricted + 1

  T <- nrow(scores)
  K <- ncol(scores)

  idx <- (p_full + 1):T

  Y <- scores[idx, , drop = FALSE]

  X_restricted <- matrix(1, nrow = length(idx), ncol = 1)

  if (p_restricted > 0) {
    for (j in 1:p_restricted) {
      X_restricted <- cbind(
        X_restricted,
        scores[idx - j, , drop = FALSE]
      )
    }
  }

  X_full <- X_restricted

  X_full <- cbind(
    X_full,
    scores[idx - p_full, , drop = FALSE]
  )

  coef_restricted <- solve(
    crossprod(X_restricted),
    crossprod(X_restricted, Y)
  )

  coef_full <- solve(
    crossprod(X_full),
    crossprod(X_full, Y)
  )

  resid_restricted <- Y - X_restricted %*% coef_restricted
  resid_full <- Y - X_full %*% coef_full

  Sigma_restricted <- crossprod(resid_restricted) / nrow(resid_restricted)
  Sigma_full <- crossprod(resid_full) / nrow(resid_full)

  stat <- nrow(Y) * (
    safe_logdet(Sigma_restricted, ridge = ridge) -
      safe_logdet(Sigma_full, ridge = ridge)
  )

  df <- K * K

  p_value <- pchisq(
    stat,
    df = df,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    test = paste0("FAR(", p_restricted, ") vs FAR(", p_full, ")"),
    p_restricted = p_restricted,
    p_full = p_full,
    K = K,
    n_eff = nrow(Y),
    statistic = stat,
    df = df,
    p_value = p_value
  )
}

select_order_far_KR_style <- function(X,
                                      p_max = 5,
                                      K = NULL,
                                      pve = 0.95,
                                      alpha = 0.05,
                                      center = TRUE,
                                      ridge = 1e-8)
{
  score_out <- make_scores_for_far_order(
    X = X,
    K = K,
    pve = pve,
    center = center
  )

  scores <- score_out$scores

  test_table <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      0:(p_max - 1),
      function(p0) {
        kr_test_one_lag(
          scores = scores,
          p_restricted = p0,
          ridge = ridge
        )
      }
    )
  )

  reject_vec <- test_table$p_value < alpha

  if (!reject_vec[1]) {
    p_hat <- 0
  } else {
    first_non_reject <- which(!reject_vec)

    if (length(first_non_reject) == 0) {
      p_hat <- p_max
    } else {
      p_hat <- test_table$p_restricted[first_non_reject[1]]
    }
  }

  list(
    p_hat = p_hat,
    test_table = test_table,
    K = score_out$K,
    pve_used = score_out$pve,
    score_detail = score_out
  )
}
```



```{r}
run_KR_check_after_fracdiff <- function(X,
                                        d_hat,
                                        p_max = 5,
                                        K = NULL,
                                        pve = 0.95,
                                        alpha = 0.05,
                                        fracdiff_trim = 100,
                                        center = TRUE)
{
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  if (d_hat == 0) {
    X_diff <- X
  } else {
    X_diff <- FracDiff(
      x = t(X),
      d = d_hat
    ) %>%
      t()
  }

  if (d_hat == 0) {
    X_diff_use <- X_diff
  } else {
    X_diff_use <- X_diff[, (fracdiff_trim + 1):ncol(X_diff), drop = FALSE]
  }

  out <- select_order_far_KR_style(
    X = X_diff_use,
    p_max = p_max,
    K = K,
    pve = pve,
    alpha = alpha,
    center = center
  )

  list(
    d_hat = d_hat,
    p_hat_KR = out$p_hat,
    K = out$K,
    pve_used = out$pve_used,
    test_table = out$test_table,
    X_diff_use = X_diff_use
  )
}
```

```{r}
make_CIDR_curves <- function(X_price,
                             step = 5,
                             scale = 100) {
  
  X_price <- as.matrix(X_price)
  storage.mode(X_price) <- "numeric"
  
  X_price[X_price <= 0] <- NA_real_
  
  idx_5min <- seq(1, nrow(X_price), by = step)
  
  X_5min_price <- X_price[idx_5min, , drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_col <- apply(
    X_5min_price,
    2,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X_5min_price <- X_5min_price[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  log_price <- log(X_5min_price)
  
  X_CIDR <- scale * sweep(
    log_price,
    MARGIN = 2,
    STATS = log_price[1, ],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  X_CIDR <- X_CIDR[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  
  rownames(X_CIDR) <- paste0("u", seq_len(nrow(X_CIDR)))
  
  X_CIDR
}
```

```{r}
  X <- X[keep_row, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
library(fds)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

data(SAelectdemand)

extract_fds_matrix <- function(obj) {
  
  if (!is.null(obj$y)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$y)
  } else if (!is.null(obj$data)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$data)
  } else if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    X <- obj
  } else {
    stop("Cannot extract matrix.")
  }
  
  storage.mode(X) <- "numeric"
  X
}

prepare_positive_X <- function(X, small_value = 10^-6) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  X[is.na(X)] <- small_value
  X[X <= 0] <- small_value
  
  X <- log(X)
  
  keep_col <- apply(
    X,
    2,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_row <- apply(
    X,
    1,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[keep_row, , drop = FALSE]
  
  X
}

center_by_weekday_whole <- function(X, dates) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  weekday <- weekdays(dates)
  
  X_centered <- X
  
  for (g in unique(weekday)) {
    
    idx <- which(weekday == g)
    
    mean_g <- rowMeans(
      X[, idx, drop = FALSE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    X_centered[, idx] <- sweep(
      X[, idx, drop = FALSE],
      MARGIN = 1,
      STATS = mean_g,
      FUN = "-"
    )
  }
  
  X_centered
}

difference_weekly <- function(X, lag = 7) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  X_diff <- X[, (lag + 1):ncol(X), drop = FALSE] -
    X[, 1:(ncol(X) - lag), drop = FALSE]
  
  X_diff
}

screen_one_version <- function(X,
                               dataset,
                               fracdiff_trim = 100,
                               seed = 111) {
  
  out <- tryCatch(
    screen_order_selection_compact(
      X = X,
      train_ratio = 0.6,
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = 199,
      fracdiff_trim = fracdiff_trim,
      seed = seed
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  
  if (inherits(out, "error")) {
    return(
      tibble(
        dataset = dataset,
        T = ncol(X),
        d_hat = NA_real_,
        p_est = NA_integer_,
        q_est = NA_integer_,
        total_order = NA_integer_,
        error_message = out$message
      )
    )
  }
  
  out$model_summary %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = dataset,
      total_order = p_est + q_est,
      error_message = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(
      dataset,
      T,
      train_end,
      d_hat,
      p_est,
      q_est,
      total_order,
      fracdiff_trim,
      error_message,
      everything()
    )
}

X_elect_raw <- extract_fds_matrix(SAelectdemand)

X_elect_log <- prepare_positive_X(
  X = X_elect_raw
)

dates_elect <- seq(
  as.Date("1997-07-06"),
  by = "day",
  length.out = ncol(X_elect_log)
)

X_elect_weekday_centered <- center_by_weekday_whole(
  X = X_elect_log,
  dates = dates_elect
)

X_elect_weekly_diff <- difference_weekly(
  X = X_elect_log,
  lag = 7
)
```

```{r}
compare_one_origin_rmse <- function(
    result,
    X,
    step_show = 40,
    window_show = "expanding",
    methods_show = c("farma", "far")
) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  result$error_detail %>%
    filter(
      window_type == window_show,
      step == step_show,
      method %in% methods_show
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rmse_by_h = map(error, function(e_mat) {
        tibble(
          h = seq_len(ncol(e_mat)),
          RMSE = apply(e_mat, 2, function(z) sqrt(mean(z^2, na.rm = TRUE))),
          MAE = apply(e_mat, 2, function(z) mean(abs(z), na.rm = TRUE))
        )
      })
    ) %>%
    select(method, window_type, step, t0, rmse_by_h) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(rmse_by_h)
}
```

```{r}
library(arfima)

one_run <- function(T = 200, d_true = 0.3, phi = 0.9, p_max = 5) {
  
  x <- arfima::arfima.sim(
    n = T,
    model = list(
      phi = phi,
      dfrac = d_true,
      theta = numeric(0)
    )
  )
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  
  d_direct <- local_whittle(x)
  
  ar_fit <- ar(x, aic = TRUE, order.max = p_max, demean = TRUE)
  e <- ar_fit$resid
  e <- e[!is.na(e)]
  
  d_filtered <- local_whittle(e)
  
  c(
    d_true = d_true,
    phi = phi,
    d_direct = d_direct,
    d_filtered = d_filtered,
    ar_order = ar_fit$order
  )
}

sim_study <- function(R = 100,
                      T_vals = c(200, 500, 1000),
                      d_vals = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5),
                      phi_vals = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 0.9),
                      p_max = 5) {
  
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (T in T_vals) {
    for (d in d_vals) {
      for (phi in phi_vals) {
        
        res <- replicate(
          R,
          one_run(T = T, d_true = d, phi = phi, p_max = p_max),
          simplify = TRUE
        )
        
        res <- as.data.frame(t(res))
        res$T <- T
        out[[k]] <- res
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

set.seed(123)
sim_res <- sim_study(R = 100)

summary_res <- aggregate(
  cbind(d_direct, d_filtered) ~ T + d_true + phi,
  data = sim_res,
  FUN = mean
)

summary_res$bias_direct <- summary_res$d_direct - summary_res$d_true
summary_res$bias_filtered <- summary_res$d_filtered - summary_res$d_true

summary_res
```
